changes: Retrig Grid by stigmagit is now part of this module: while the sequencer plays, pad retrigs fall on its swung grid. Turn it off with QUANT RTRG TO SEQ in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG.
A recorded roll's first trig moves to the grid too; the press still sounds where you played it.
While a roll records, the grid follows swing only, so a long roll no longer shifts by the trigs it just wrote.
The RTRG key glows dim red while the selected track is ALWAYS ON.
Do not install the separate Retrig Grid module beside this one. Not yet tested: external MIDI clock.
